notes.title: New Official Mod "RTA-chan" is Here!
notes.notes:
The biggest speedrunning event in Japan, RTA in Japan Summer 2023, was held from August 10 to 15, 2023, and TOKOYO: The Tower of Perpetuity was featured in the event!

Speedrunning, or RTA (Real Time Attack) in Japan, is where you try to beat a game as fast as possible and compare your time with other players.

You can watch an archived VOD for the TOKOYO run on Twitch or YouTube, so check it out if you're interested!
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1896686814]Twitch[/url] / [url=https://youtu.be/Q2DsKccG6no]YouTube[/url]

To commemorate TOKOYO's participation in the event, we've added RTA-chan, the mascot character for RTA in Japan, to the game as an official mod.
The mod comes with an original story as well, so do your best to beat it, or maybe even attempt a speedrun yourself!

notes.title: Nominate TOKOYO: The Tower of Perpetuity for the Steam Awards!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Nominations for Steam Awards is now open, and we would like to ask for your support in nominating [i]TOKOYO: The Tower of Perpetuity[/i] for the "Most Innovative Gameplay" Award.

This game combines a tower that changes completely every 24 hours and some light social features, 2 elements that are rarely (if ever!) combined together. Climb the tower and compete with players from all over the globe, the one who sits atop the rankings at the end of each 24-hour cycle shall be king for the day!

What's more, you can freely customize and make your very own character that you can control to conquer the tower with. 

All these elements add up to give you a fun and unique experience you won't find anywhere else and we hope you can help us help the game gain the recognition it deserves!

notes.title: TOKOYO: The Tower of Perpetuity Full Version is Finally Here!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Once again, a massive thank you to all of you who have been waiting for TOKOYO: The Tower of Perpetuity's full release. We really really appreciate your patience as we continued to get the game ready for this huge day.

As of now the game has officially graduated from Early Access into the full 1.0 version! We hope you're excited for the powered-up version of the game!

In the full version, you will be able to enjoy the following features:
[list]
[*]True boss and true ending implemented
[*]Steam Achievements
[*]New collectibles
[*]New maps (over 300!) and gimmicks
[*]Practive mode with challenging bosses
[/list]

Furthermore, the full version also features official playable custom characters created by popular streamers, illustrators, and game designers. We have plans to bolster the character lineup even more, so stay tuned! Playable custom characters right now include:

[list]
[*]Magurona, The VTuber Devil Queen by popular Japanese Virtual YouTuber (@ukyo_rst)
[*]Diane the Mighty Goose cosplayer by Mighty Goose developer Richard Lems (@rilemtwit)
[*]Sedeto the twinkle maker by Pop-culture lover and amazing graphics designer Sedeto (@Sedeto)
[/list]

Many artists and illustrators have also blessed us with their amazing artwork, all of which will appear in a random order as loading screens while playing the game!

Finally, the original 13-track soundtrack for the game is also available for $4.99. For those of you who want even more TOKOYO in your lives, this may be perfect for you!

notes.title: Update: Addition of Gravity Orb and New Maps, Notice About Server Change
notes.notes:
Dear Users,

Thank you very much for your continued support.
An update has gone live, please read on to find out more about the changes.

[list]
[*]Server Migration
Following the end of service for Tokoyo: The Tower of Perpetuity's server, we have switched over to a brand new service, which unfortunately will cause the number of candies to be reset. As such, we will set the starting candy amount at 380 for November.
[*]Added 12 new maps.
[*]Added Gravity Orbs
When you are in contact with the aura of a suspicious purple orb, your jumping ability will be significantly increased and your descending speed will be significantly decreased. Be extra careful in areas with Succubus and Harpies.
[*]Increased Imibi's skill power by 20%.
[*]Several minor adjustments and bug fixes.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789042/16a3a924a97ed0dbf31d24150df5359e839149c0.gif[/img]

[b]Update[/b]
Firstly, we would like to apologize for the delay with this update. The main reason we could not deliver on time was the unexpected end of service of our server. As a result, we had to reconstruct the game's backend, which caused the delay. However, we are currently working on a huge update in preparation for the game's full release, so please stay tuned!

notes.title: How to prevent the can't login while startup.
notes.notes:
Dear fans,

Thank you for playing TOKOYO.

Please see the following prevention for help while below cases.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789042/c852f8b270d38a8121d4d5d9ae7604265957fdc7.png[/img]

[olist]
[*]Start the Windows Registry Editor and delete all the properties in "HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software//commentout\TOKOYO NO TOU".
[*]Connect your PC to the Internet and start from the Steam Launcher.
[/olist]

We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused you.

notes.title: TOKOYO: The Tower of Perpetuity joins the Steam Game Festival!
notes.notes:
Social 2D rogue-like TOKOYO: The Tower of Perpetuity pits you against a plethora of monsters and traps. The tower is procedurally generated every 24 hours so the layout shifts.

[h2]Game Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Aim to be the best in the world in a dungeon that is procedurally generated every 24 hours!
[*] When you game over, your gravestone and items along with your final words will appear in other people's games.
[*] Character customization! Challenge the tower with your very own customized character skin!
[/list]

[previewyoutube=hFbyL9LH-S8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]About the Demo[/h2]
You will be able to play up until the first boss in this demo. Only one playable character is available.

[h2]About the Developer
[/h2]Created by solo indie developer Saebashi of the doujin cirle //commentout. This title is the first game developed by Saebashi using Unity.
[h3]
Developer Comment[/h3]
[quote=author] Although not yet complete, I really wanted to provide a demo for you all to play. I hope you can try it out and experience the game as a sort of open beta test. 
The Dress Up Mod is also functional.[/quote] 

Release is planned for 2020. If you enjoyed the demo then don't forget to add it to your wishlists!

notes.title: TOKOYO: The Tower of Perpetuity - social Rogue-like 2D action (2020 release)!
notes.notes:
Fight your way through a constantly changing tower to solidify your eternal legacy!

You find yourself trapped in a mysterious tower – one that transforms its very structure every 24 hours, where you must surpass countless poor fallen souls and make your way to the heretofore unseen top!

[previewyoutube=hFbyL9LH-S8;full][/previewyoutube]

This ""social Rogue-like 2D action game"" is set in Tokoyo – the Tower of Perpetuity – a constantly changing and devilishly deceptive auto-generated dungeon crawling with fiendish monsters and brutal traps. It was developed by solo indie developer Saebashi's personal dev circle known as //commentout.
In stark contrast with the cute character design, the action and boss battles are pretty tough, providing endless fun for those who like a real challenge.

This title is scheduled for a 2020 release, so please be sure to add it to your Wish List!
